_how_to_add: Put the image in assets/charts/ (optionally also a smaller .webp for display), then add an entry at the TOP of 'charts' (newest first): file = full-size image, display = optional smaller version shown in the card, title, caption, credit, source (optional URL), added (YYYY-MM-DD). The page sorts by 'added', newest first.

charts.title: SPX Quartercent Cycles Theory
charts.caption: Third-party chart, shown as published; it illustrates a cycle theory, not established fact. S&P 500 on a log scale from 1927 to the present, overlaid with a sine-wave cycle of roughly 25-year expansion phases separated by about 9–12-year 'Pause' periods (1929–42, 1966–75, 2000–09), with projected markers at '28, '34 and '41.
